# xAGI Labs

> AI training data sourcing, custom collection scoping and licensing. Source availability, volume and permitted use are established for each brief; this is not an inventory catalog.

- [Data sourcing](https://xagi.in/ai-dataset-sourcing/)
- [Custom collection](https://xagi.in/custom-ai-data-collection/)
- [Dataset licensing](https://xagi.in/ai-dataset-licensing/)
- [Discuss a dataset](https://xagi.in/#dataset-brief)
- [Projects](https://xagi.in/portfolio/)
- [Speech research](https://xagi.in/projects/haryanvi-tts/)
- [Blog](https://xagi.in/blog/)
- [AI news](https://xagi.in/ai-news/)
- [Engineering services](https://xagi.in/services/)
- [API retirement notice](https://xagi.in/docs/api/)

Existing product and engineering pages remain available. Haryanvi TTS is research in progress, not proof of a licensable commercial corpus. The former chat and slide-generation APIs remain retired.

Public pages may be used for search and live AI grounding. Model training is disallowed by robots.txt. Dataset usage requires a separate source-specific agreement.
